phase_name: Generated Sentinel and Milestone Render Path

objectives.description: In `roadmap-preflight-lib.sh` define the sentinel constant (a fixed HTML comment naming the generator and "do not edit") and add a `generated` verdict to `detec
In `roadmap-integration.sh` add the whole-file render, selected when `roadmap_milestones` is present, in this order: sentinel; `# Roadmap`; `primary_goals` bull
Milestone section: heading `## {id}: {title}` with an explicit anchor derived from the stored `id`; `aim`; a Progress line (`status`, derived batch and task don
A member that is terminal in `active_projects` or present in the archive's completed list counts as done and is left off the `/orchestrate` line; a batch with n
Last section: `overview`, `rules`, `conventions`, then the list of open tasks in no batch.
Do not render `rationale`. Do not call `generate-task-order.sh --print` on this path.
Resolve the output path through the accessor when `--roadmap` is not given. `--regenerate` on this path writes when the target classifies `generated` or `absent
Keep `--print`, `--dry-run`, the six-field stderr marker (`runs=` = open-milestone batch count, `retained=` = 0), the `OUTCOME:` line and the `no content change
Add a milestone group to `test-roadmap-generation.sh`: section order, anchors from `id`, derived counts with a completed member, a done batch, a collapsed close

deviations.reason: A member absent from active_projects counts as done when it appears in any archive list (archived_projects, completed_projects, abandoned_projects), not only completed_projects; an active entry always wins over an archive entry with the same number.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — any archive list counts, active entry wins)*

deviations.description: Empty open milestone and done batch wording
deviations.reason: An open milestone with no batches renders `no batches yet` instead of 0/0 counts, and a done batch renders as one line with no member lines.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — empty milestone says no batches yet; done batch is one line)*

verification_notes:
- Verified from the source store (CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store run-all.sh --only): test-roadmap-generation.sh (132 cases, the 106 prior cases unedited), test-migrate-roadmap-next-to-state.sh, test-orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh, test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh, test-sweep-invalidated-claims.sh, test-roadmap-entries-lib.sh, test-lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh: 7 passed, 0 failed. shellcheck -S warning and check-task-references.sh clean.
- The renderer hard-sources lib/roadmap-entries-lib.sh; any sandbox that runs it must copy that lib.
- RUNS_COUNT for the milestone shape is computed at file scope (a value set inside the --print command substitution never reaches the marker).
- A milestone store whose target is classic/stage/unknown still falls through to the old code until Phase 6; Phase 5's migration must therefore write the generated file itself (remove the old file, then --regenerate onto absent, or move a --print render into place).
- Anchors: milestone-{id lowercased}; last section anchor roadmap-context.
